result.title: From Policy Evaluation to Off-Policy Control: Provable Emergence of In-Context Q-Learning
result.summary: Transformers can implement reinforcement-learning algorithms in context, yet how off-policy control emerges within Transformers remains poorly understood. We study Q-learning, a foundational model-free control algorithm that combines off-policy bootstrapping with greedy policy improvement. We prove that a two-layer attention-only Transformer can implement a finite-temperature form of Q-learning, where the temperature $τ>0$ controls the approximation to greedy action selection, recovering window Q-learning as $τ\to0$. We train the structured Transformer on randomly generated MDP tasks using output-only supervision. Experiments show that the theoretically predicted parameter structure emerges during training, including the internal greedy action-selection mechanism, and that the trained Transformer achieves performance comparable to Q-learning on unseen tasks. Our theoretical analysis further shows that the equivalent realizations form a solution manifold and that, under suitable task-diversity conditions, the training iterates converge locally to this manifold at an exponential rate. For the random-task model analyzed here, the local worst-case number of gradient steps needed to reduce the distance to the manifold by a factor $ε$ is $Θ\left(τ^{-5}\log(1/\varepsilon)\right)$, quantifying the increasing optimization cost as the learned update approaches window Q-learning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文证明两层纯注意力 Transformer 能在上下文中实现有限温度形式的 Q-learning（τ→0 时退化为 window Q-learning），仅用输出级监督在随机 MDP 任务上训练，验证理论预测的参数结构与内部贪心动作选择机制会随训练涌现，并分析收敛到解流形的梯度步数随 τ 增大的代价。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及视觉或多模态，但其「Transformer 在上下文中实现迭代式自举状态更新」与「输出监督下内部算法回路可被证明地涌现并收敛到解流形」的结论，或可为 LVR 的循环/迭代隐状态生成、轨迹训练与监督分配提供方法线索，需核查其可迁移性。
